steps.title: Frame the decision
steps.instructions: Reconstructed workflow from the published prompt and available result artifacts; this is not a recorded sequence of agent turns. Use only the six-slide brief and supplied illustrative solar inputs. Derive the 5.8-year simple payback; leave unspecified assumptions as TBD.

steps.title: Build editable slides
steps.instructions: Use the pinned PowerPoint skill to implement the six ordered communication jobs with native text, shapes, diagrams, metrics, table and speaker notes.

steps.title: Review the deck
steps.instructions: Check arithmetic, units, consistency, clipping and editability against the prompt. The published slide images are visual references; they do not independently prove every object in the original deck is editable.
